up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL4703 (Serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A catalytic subunit alpha isoform). Filter for exact IC50 measurements (standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=') with non-null pChEMBL values. Return: assay chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule chembl_id and assay chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS "assay chembl_id", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id AS "tax_id", cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule chembl_id", act.standard_type AS "standard type", act.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4703' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
